issue_context.title: The serializer works incorrectly with records
comments:
I've noticed an issue with record serialization as well. My scenario is slightly different, but also involves records with inheritance hierarchy:

```
    [Immutable]
    [GenerateSerializer]
    public abstract record Identity(Guid Id);

    [Immutable]
    [GenerateSerializer]
    public record SomeIdentity(Guid Id) : Identity(Id);

    public interface IMyGrain
    {
        Task<List<SomeIdentity>> GetIdentities();
    }
```

When the `GetIdentities()` method is called, a List is returned to the client, but it contains only 1 element, even if the grain returned a List instance with more elements.

```
var results = await this.Client.GetGrain<IMyGrain>("some id").GetIdentities();
```

I've debugged through the generated code, and can confirm that the serializer is called for each element in the source List<T>. 
The serializer is actually processing the list twice. 
However, the `results` List contains only the first element from the source collection.

Please note that removing the parameter from the base record doesn't cause this issue:

```
    [Immutable]
    [GenerateSerializer]
    public record SomeIdentity(Guid Id) : Identity();
```

I suspect the `SomeIdentity` serializer may be confused by the fact that the `Id` is actually present on the base type.
I opened a PR with a fix (linked above, I'm on mobile right now). I'll see if that also fixes your case. I think it will.

Thank you so much! 
Do you have any fix release planned? If not, are there any chances for a pre-release nuget package?
